recipes.title: Tomato Basil Pasta
instructions: Boil pasta in salted water until al dente.
Sauté garlic in olive oil, add chopped tomatoes and basil.
Toss pasta with the sauce and finish with parmesan.

recipes.title: Shakshuka with Eggs
instructions: Simmer crushed tomatoes with onion, pepper, and spices.
Make wells in the sauce and crack eggs into each well.
Cover and cook until whites set; serve with bread.

recipes.title: Chicken Veggie Stir Fry
instructions: Slice chicken and vegetables into bite-size pieces.
Stir-fry chicken until golden, then add vegetables.
Finish with soy sauce, garlic, and sesame oil.

recipes.title: Spinach & Feta Omelette
instructions: Whisk eggs with salt and pepper.
Cook spinach briefly, add eggs, and fold in feta.
